definitions.explanation: An edible bivalve mollusk, widely eaten raw or cooked in Japanese cuisine. Japan is one of the world's largest oyster producers.

examples.japanese: {冬|ふゆ}は{牡蠣|かき}が{旬|しゅん}だ。
examples.english: Oysters are in season in winter.

examples.japanese: {広島|ひろしま}は{牡蠣|かき}の{産地|さんち}として{有名|ゆうめい}だ。
examples.english: Hiroshima is famous as an oyster-producing region.

notes:
WRITING:
Often written in katakana as カキ, especially on menus and in food contexts. The kanji {牡蠣|かき} is used in formal writing.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Oysters are a major winter delicacy in Japan. {広島|ひろしま} and {宮城|みやぎ} are the top producing prefectures. Common preparations include {生|なま}ガキ (raw), {焼|や}きガキ (grilled), and {牡蠣|かき}フライ (deep-fried).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {牡蠣|かき}フライ: deep-fried oyster
- {焼|や}きガキ: grilled oyster
- {生|なま}ガキ: raw oyster
- {殻付|からつ}きガキ: oyster in the shell
- {牡蠣|かき}にあたる: to get food poisoning from oysters
